prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 night film still. A young man in his early twenties with short dark hair and an untucked white going-out shirt, flushed and a little sweaty, stands outside a British pub at closing time, mid-sentence, grinning with drunk certainty as he thrusts a lanyard of car keys up toward the camera. Low-angle medium close-up on an 85mm lens at f/1.4: his face is razor sharp, the dangling keys catch a glint, and the street behind him dissolves into huge soft bokeh circles of warm amber, red, a little pink and cyan, with two glowing yellow taxi roof signs blurred in the distance. The only light is the pub window's warm spill on his cheek and a street lamp's rim on his hair; deep inky blacks, fine film grain. Thanks.
